title: Setup → AI: several providers enabled at once, a model list per provider, one default and one structured-output model; legacy settings read unchanged
body:
epic:#5055#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMmczBEaeiAQ48oDtz

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task · Source: objectstack-ai/cloud#5055 — Jack 2026-11-26: 「分阶段实施，第一阶段先能把多个模型配置上。」「开专区派发 AI 模型档位方案」
Grade: p2 · area:ai · Task · evidence: read (objectstack main dedc16c1)
Reader: epic:#5055 seat (objectstack-ai/cloud#5055) → card thread. Milestone M1.
Dedupe: open objectstack issues on `ai.manifest` multi-provider → checked, none with this mechanism.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：私有部署企业版的 Setup → AI 现在是“选一个供应商”的单选表单。改成可以同时启用多个供应商，每个供应商填多个模型，再选一个默认模型和一个结构化输出模型；每个供应商可以单独测试连接、单独关掉。
- 影响：企业版多模型的设置界面。老部署升级后设置照读、行为不变。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Current state (objectstack main dedc16c1)
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts`: scope `global` (`:31`); a single `select` key `provider` (`:51`) chooses one provider; each provider group shows only when selected (`visible: "${data.provider === '…'}"`) and has its own `*_api_key` (`password`, `encrypted: true`), `*_model` and for some `*_base_url`.
- Specifier kinds are closed (`packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts:36`); the `map` specifier's column kinds are only `duration` and `positive_integer` (`:84`), so a free-form list of providers with an encrypted key per row is not expressible without an ADR-0007 amendment.
- The cloud consumer reads these keys (`objectstack-ai/cloud` `packages/service-ai/src/plugin.ts` settings builds, live action `ai/test` at `:1875`).

Re-check: `git grep -n "key: 'provider'" -- packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts` → 1 hit.

## What to do
1. Let several providers be enabled at once over the existing per-provider groups (keys stay one encrypted `password` field per provider, never echoed): a per-provider on/off, and per provider a list of model ids.
2. One default model and one structured-output model (separate knob, cloud#797), both chosen from the enabled providers' models; saving refuses a default that is not among them.
3. Legacy settings read unchanged: a stored single `provider` + `<provider>_model` with no new keys means "that provider enabled, that model as its only model and the default". No data rewrite is required for an upgraded deployment to behave as before.
4. A test-connection action per provider group (the cloud host registers the live handler).
5. Use only the existing specifier kinds. If the shape cannot be expressed without a new specifier kind or `map` column kind, stop with `needs_decision` (ADR-0007 contract change).

## Acceptance
- Manifest tests: two providers enabled with two models each validate; a default outside the enabled models is refused with a named error; a legacy single-provider value set reads as one enabled provider with that model as default.
- No key value appears in any read of the settings.
- `Metadata-protocol:` line per AGENTS.md (settings manifests are platform metadata; likely `none` or `added`, the dev decides from the diff), changeset for `@objectstack/service-settings`.

## Fences
- File surface: `packages/services/service-settings/**` (manifest, its tests, translations if the manifest's labels are translated), one changeset. ⛔ No `packages/spec` change; stop if one is needed.
- Cloud consumes this after a pin move; that is a separate cloud card of objectstack-ai/cloud#5055.

## References
Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/3sJqSZVv3Lf3NoViD9Q4cU (section 方案 4). Parent objectstack-ai/cloud#5055.
